simple.summary: צוֹא (tsôwʼ) means soiled (as if excrementitious) First listed occurrence: Zech 3 3.

definitions.full: H6674. tso or tsoi [ צֹאִי ] adjective filthy ; — plural צוֺאִים Zech 3:3 , צֹאִים 3:4 (both of garments). צַוָּאר see I. צור .
definitions.rootNote: or צֹא ; from an unused root meaning to issue;
